items.title: csr record schema: round gains required findings + dispositions
items.scope: convergence-record.schema.json round $defs gains required findings (doc-findings shape) + required dispositions (defect_id/action fixed|rejected|escalated/note)
items.risk: schema back-compat: old counts-only records no longer validate (accepted, pre-ADR); test fixtures churn

items.title: converge.py pass-through: findings + dispositions into the record
items.scope: converge.py emits per-round findings + dispositions from run.json; run.json input shape gains required per-round dispositions array; jsonschema validation covers both
items.risk: dispositions missing -> engine must REJECT (never silently omit); old fixtures updated

items.title: csr SKILL.md step-2 + step-4 wording
items.scope: step 2: record accept/reject/escalate + rationale per defect_id at reconcile time (escalate target = human, stated explicitly); step 4: per-round findings + dispositions replaces findings trend
items.risk: wording drift vs schema enums (rule 10: one enumeration per concept)

items.title: csr test fixtures: embedded findings + dispositions
items.scope: convergence_policy_check.py + findings_shape_check.py fixtures include records with findings + dispositions; round-trip asserts record-with-findings validates

items.title: csr ADR log + doc-audit
items.scope: create skills/cross-source-review/docs/design-decisions.md (sibling convention) with the 3 pre-ADRs + escalate-target note; doc-audit grep for stale round-shape enumerations
items.risk: missed enumeration in references/*.md (install.md gate tables etc.)

items.title: psv SKILL.md: packet persistence + extractor guidance
items.scope: step 4: per-claim doc-findings packet persisted as a file beside the coverage-record; extractor guidance: prefer durable in-repo sources; volatile sources flagged
items.risk: packet shape vs SKILL.md line 57 definition (verified counted-not-listed must stay)

items.title: psv coverage-record schema: volatile-authority registry
items.scope: coverage-record.schema.json gains volatile-authority registry (claim_ref -> volatile source; covers verified claims too); coverage_policy_check.py validates
items.risk: registry completeness (verified-claim sources are counted-not-listed -> registry is their only signal)

items.title: psv test fixtures: packet + registry
items.scope: psv test fixtures include a packet-with-registry record; coverage_policy_check + fetched_quote_gate stay green

items.title: jsonschema into dev deps
items.scope: pyproject.toml [project.optional-dependencies] dev + [dependency-groups] dev gain jsonschema; uv sync succeeds; converge.py under repo venv validates without SKIP note
items.risk: uv.lock regeneration; graceful-skip machinery stays as bare-python fallback

items.title: full self-gate sweep
items.scope: csr + psv full test suites green under repo venv; no SKIP note; the audit's two record-layer defects demonstrably closed
items.risk: residual flake in dogfood.py (token/network skip paths)
